turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant calling from Northgate Lettings about the enquiry you made on our website. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I didn't make an enquiry. I'm already one of your tenants, I'm ringing about my boiler, it's been off since Sunday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great news, the Elm Road two bedroom is available from the first of next month at fourteen hundred. When are you hoping to move?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not moving. I need someone to look at the boiler.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Would Saturday at eleven suit for a viewing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Forget it, I'll ring the office.
